wer: it’s close, but I wouldn’t ship it as-is. Biggest issues are security, API shape, and a couple React gotchas. Here’s the quick read + a drop-in, production-safe fix.
What’s good

Clean UI with Tailwind; nice loading/error states.

Retry with exponential backoff 👍

Sensible state model (prompt / imageUrl / isLoading / error).

Blockers to fix

Do not call Google's image API from the browser with an API key.
Your key will be exposed and abused. Put the call behind a server/serverless"
